end.summary: Practised English names for farm animals: hen, duck, rooster, sheep, and others.
end.parentNote: Krish practised naming farm animals in English and connected “baa” with sheep and “kukdoo-koo” with a rooster. They sometimes gave the animal sound instead of the English animal name, and this mix-up was still present at the end. At home, show one farm-animal picture at a time and ask, “What is its English name?” Krish also said, “kabhi kabhi lagta hai main na hoti toh achha hota” (“sometimes I feel it would be better if I weren’t there”); please check in with them calmly and directly about this today and seek immediate local support if they may be in danger.
